note: Long-lived Instagram User Access Token, generated by hand in the App Dashboard when the pipeline went live. Meta gives these 60 days. The date is recorded to the start of the day on purpose: the countdown should be pessimistic, never optimistic. Update issuedAt whenever the token in the environment is replaced.
howToRenew: Meta App Dashboard > the app > Instagram > API setup with Instagram login > Generate token. Paste the new value into the cloud environment variable IG_ACCESS_TOKEN, then set issuedAt here to that day and commit.
